description: The RemoveAt node takes in a Collection and the index to remove an element from that list.

fields.* ([[Impulses|Call]]): Calls an impulse to remove the element at the preferred index or position from the list.
fields.Index: The index or position of the element we want to remove from the list. (min: 0, max: Count of collection minus 1)
fields.Collection: The collection to remove the element form.
fields.OnRemove: Fires when successfully removing the element from the list.
fields.OnFail: Fires if unable to remove the element from the list or if the index is out of bounds of the collection.
